INSERT INTO role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.role_id, p.permission_id FROM role r CROSS JOIN permission p WHERE r.role_name = 'BRAND_EDITOR' AND p.permission_key IN ( 'COLLECTION:WITHDRAW_FROM_REVIEW', 'TEMPLATE:DELETE', 'TEMPLATE:CLONE', 'TEMPLATE:SUBMIT_FOR_REVIEW', 'TEMPLATE:WITHDRAW_FROM_REVIEW', 'TEMPLATE:VIEW_VALIDATION_RESULTS', 'MEDIA_ASSET:UPLOAD', 'MEDIA_ASSET:READ', 'MEDIA_ASSET:UPDATE_METADATA', 'MEDIA_ASSET:REPLACE', 'MEDIA_ASSET:ATTACH', 'MEDIA_ASSET:DETACH', 'MEDIA_ASSET:VIEW_VALIDATION_RESULTS' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.role_id AND rp.permission_id = p.permission_id );
INSERT INTO role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.role_id, p.permission_id FROM role r CROSS JOIN permission p WHERE r.role_name = 'BRAND_ADMIN' AND p.permission_key IN ( 'COLLECTION:WITHDRAW_FROM_REVIEW', 'COLLECTION:APPROVE', 'COLLECTION:PUBLISH', 'COLLECTION:RETIRE', 'TEMPLATE:DELETE', 'TEMPLATE:CLONE', 'TEMPLATE:SUBMIT_FOR_REVIEW', 'TEMPLATE:WITHDRAW_FROM_REVIEW', 'TEMPLATE:PUBLISH', 'TEMPLATE:RETIRE', 'TEMPLATE:VIEW_VALIDATION_RESULTS', 'MEDIA_ASSET:UPLOAD', 'MEDIA_ASSET:READ', 'MEDIA_ASSET:UPDATE_METADATA', 'MEDIA_ASSET:REPLACE', 'MEDIA_ASSET:DELETE', 'MEDIA_ASSET:ATTACH', 'MEDIA_ASSET:DETACH', 'MEDIA_ASSET:VIEW_VALIDATION_RESULTS' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.role_id AND rp.permission_id = p.permission_id );
